correctness: Both arms: existing Unicode row-edge and wide-boundary parser differential tests, full release terminal suite, 64 seeds x 200 stream differential. Existing tests identical in both arms. No timer before correctness.

engine.primary: Unicode median paired CPU-rate ratio >=1.02, wins>losses, six-workload Holm p<.05, and all six median CPU ratios >=.98. Point guards are not noninferiority proof.
engine.stop: Exactly 12 pairs, no pilots, exclusions, rescue variant, extra timing, pooling, optional stopping or threshold changes. Reject if screen fails; separate fresh PTY/Ghostty and all-metric gates before any promotion.

hypothesis: Joint pair replacement may shorten emitted cell-drop/store bookkeeping without changing terminal semantics.
label: Safe two-cell array assignment for a wide base and spacer
limits: Sequential shared-host engine diagnostic; not terminal/Ghostty or championship inference. Cell stores and code layout may change together.
mechanism: Compare exact release code generation before timing; stop without timing if relocation-masked hot instructions identical. No instrumented rates.
no_codegen_change: If instruction sequences are unchanged, stop before timing.
semantic_scope: Only put_row wide-width store uses a two-element mutable array view and aggregate assignment; narrow path, width/guard/cursor/wrap/zero-mark handling unchanged.
